title: Mode 3: Test harness (P/F/O/S/B/ST/SEC suites)
description:
Implement Mode 3 test harness from docs/plans/14-mode3-e2e-test-harness.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P5: lifecycle FSM, snapshot monotonicity, rollback consistency, dispatch integrity, event/RPC correlation
- Fault injection F1-F8: RPC transient failure, host restart, rollback race, pause/resume race, event stream interruption, TCP reset, TLS cert rotation, network partition
- Oracle O1-O3: Mode 1 vs Mode 3 parity, snapshot oracle, lifecycle trace replay
- Simulations S1-S3: distributed timeline, rollback branching, session recovery
- Benchmarks B1-B4: tool dispatch p95<=10ms, lifecycle p95<=100ms, rollback p95<=500ms, events>=5k/min
- Stress ST1-ST3: multi-session stress, 12h soak, burst recovery
- Security SEC1-SEC4: session isolation, snapshot auth, transport hardening, metadata redaction
- CI tier mapping: PR-fast ~15s, PR-standard ~45s, Nightly ~2h

Depends on: Mode 3 E2E core task.
